Each storyboard frame should become its own cinematic shot.

Warm taupe and muted rose-beige monochromatic palette.

Elegant editorial lighting.

glossy product reflections

oversized blazer

soft rose-beige liquid

sensual fashion-commercial atmosphere

soft whoosh transitions

Avoid:

aggressive EDM

cartoonish sounds

luxurious, mesmerizing, feminine, fashionable, refined, and emotionally immersive.

smooth orbit shot.

SCENE 3 — APPLICATION

Generate as a separate individual shot.

slow-motion macro cinematography.

Text:
“GLASS SHINE”
“INTENSE HYDRATION”

SCENE 4 — POWER LOOK

Generate as a separate individual shot.

Editorial pose beneath dramatic lighting with floating product elements and elegant flowing glossy accents.

Camera:
smooth circular motion.

Text:
“STEAL THE SHINE”

SCENE 5 — FINAL PACKSHOT

Generate as a separate individual shot.

Luxury hero product shot on reflective surface with soft cinematic lighting and elegant sparkling details.

Camera:
slow cinematic push-in.

Text:
“MOIST HEIST LIP OIL”
“SWISS BEAUTY”

FINAL OUTPUT STYLE

Premium editorial quality.
